vpn.name: Logging Policy
vpn.description: Does the privacy policy actually guarantee no logs? Has it been independently audited?

vpn.name: Jurisdiction
vpn.description: Is the company headquartered outside 14 Eyes? Does a warrant canary exist?

vpn.name: Price
vpn.description: Cost per month on the longest available plan. Lower is better.

vpn.name: Speed
vpn.description: Based on independent speed tests from AV-Comparatives and SpeedTest.net benchmarks.

vpn.name: Device Limit
vpn.description: Number of simultaneous connections allowed on one account.

vpn.name: Streaming Support
vpn.description: Works reliably with Netflix, BBC iPlayer, Disney+, and other major streaming services.

password-manager.name: Security Architecture
password-manager.description: Zero-knowledge design, end-to-end encryption, and key derivation method (PBKDF2, Argon2).

password-manager.name: Open Source
password-manager.description: Is the client code publicly auditable? Has an independent security firm audited it?

password-manager.name: Price
password-manager.description: Free tier availability and cost of premium plan.

password-manager.name: Platform Coverage
password-manager.description: Available on Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Linux, and major browser extensions.

password-manager.name: Breach History
password-manager.description: Has the company been breached? How did they respond? Transparency matters.

password-manager.name: 2FA Support
password-manager.description: Supports hardware security keys (FIDO2/WebAuthn), TOTP authenticator apps, and Duo.

antivirus.name: Detection Rate
antivirus.description: AV-TEST Institute scores for protection against malware and zero-day threats. Source: av-test.org.

antivirus.name: Performance Impact
antivirus.description: System slowdown during scans, measured by AV-TEST performance scores. Higher = less impact.

antivirus.name: Price
antivirus.description: Annual subscription cost for a single device. Free options score highest.

antivirus.name: Privacy
antivirus.description: Does the antivirus send telemetry, file samples, or browsing data back to the vendor?

antivirus.name: False Positive Rate
antivirus.description: Frequency of legitimate software flagged incorrectly. Lower false positives score higher.

2fa-apps.name: Backup & Recovery
2fa-apps.description: What happens if you lose your phone? Can you recover your 2FA codes without losing account access?

2fa-apps.name: Open Source
2fa-apps.description: Is the source code publicly auditable? Can anyone verify there are no backdoors?

2fa-apps.name: Cloud Sync
2fa-apps.description: Encrypted sync across devices. Local-only storage is more private but riskier if you lose your device.

2fa-apps.name: Platform
2fa-apps.description: Available on iOS, Android, and ideally desktop. Cross-platform scores highest.

2fa-apps.name: Ease of Use
2fa-apps.description: How straightforward is setup, adding accounts, and day-to-day use?
